snippet.title: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul - Official Gameplay Trailer | Multiplayer puzzle game
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115240?utm_source=YouTube&utm_campaign=AJotS_Trailer&utm_medium=socialmedia

First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 players.

Use your magical abilities to solve puzzles or navigate through areas!

Explore, use items, brew potions and unlock your full alchemical potential.

*PS: Don't forget to check out the Bundle section on Steam!
